# Unitopia

> A TypeScript library for type-safe dimensional quantities with unit conversion and normalization. Zero dependencies.

Unitopia provides strongly-typed representations of physical measurements (length, mass, time) and monetary values, with automatic unit conversion and array normalization capabilities.

## Core Features

- Type-safe quantity representation with compile-time unit checking
- Automatic unit conversion within dimensions
- Array normalization for collections of mixed units
- JSON serialization/deserialization
- Zero runtime dependencies
- Available dimensions: Length, Mass, Time, Money

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Complete usage guide with examples
- [API Documentation](src/main.ts): Entry point showing all exports
- [Development Guide](CLAUDE.md): Architecture and development commands

## Examples

### Creating and Converting Quantities
```typescript
import { Length, Mass } from '@zepln/unitopia'

const height = Length.Inches(71)
const heightInCm = Length.convert(height, 'Centimeter') // 180.34

const weight = Mass.Pounds(150)
const weightInKg = Mass.convert(weight, 'Kilogram') // 68.04
```

### Array Normalization
```typescript
const lengths = [Length.Inches(12), Length.Meters(0.5), Length.Feet(2)]
const normalized = Length.normalize(lengths, 'Centimeter')
// All values converted to centimeters
```

### JSON Serialization
```typescript
const m = Mass.Kilograms(75)
JSON.stringify(m) // {"dimension":"Mass","unit":"Kilogram","value":75}

const parsed = Mass.parse('{"dimension":"Mass","unit":"Kilogram","value":75}')
```

## Implementation Details

Each dimension is implemented as a TypeScript class with:
- Static factory methods for each unit (e.g., `Length.Meters()`)
- Generic type parameter for compile-time unit tracking
- Conversion tables for supported units
- Parse/tryParse methods for safe deserialization

## Installation

```bash
npm install @zepln/unitopia
# or
yarn add @zepln/unitopia
```

## Source Code Structure

- [src/length.ts](src/length.ts): Length dimension implementation
- [src/mass.ts](src/mass.ts): Mass dimension implementation  
- [src/time.ts](src/time.ts): Time dimension implementation
- [src/money.ts](src/money.ts): Money dimension implementation
- [src/quantity.ts](src/quantity.ts): Union types and dimension-agnostic parsing
- [test/](test/): Comprehensive test suite using Vitest
